checks.A: Excluded: all recorded chunks finite and shape (16,6).
checks.B: No adapter scaling defect found: normalization inverse roundtrip <=1e-8 and dataset labels match expert.
checks.C_D: Shared frame/convention path: expert 20/20; recorded-action replay seed 10 SUCCESS with max state error 3.65e-9.
checks.E: Common controller reproduces successful recorded trajectory; policy inputs already disagree with expert before contact.
checks.F: History 1, chunk 16, execution K=1, fresh observation at 15 Hz; no long open-loop chunk.
checks.G: Training/inference share bit-exact preprocessing on decoded data; actual same-seed live-vs-training raw pixel MAE 0.232/255 and video codec MAE 1.113/255. Policy also fails on its decoded training observations, so a deployment-only observation mismatch does not explain the collapse.
checks.H: Not merely final insertion tolerance: every episode fails to reach simultaneous lateral/angular alignment; minimum lateral errors range 3.06-30.43 mm.
checks.I: Supported: baseline also misses recorded training actions; episode 0 first dx becomes near-zero after first frame, required approach persists about 0.7 s.
checks.J: Excluded for observed failures: physical collision, shallow depth and lateral error all reject insertion; same detector accepts expert/replay.

next: Evaluate all-10-demo corrected training on development seeds, then all fixed held-out seeds. No held-out recovery claim yet.

optimization_findings.interpretation: Randomly initialized FrozenBatchNorm ResNet with large image feature scale and attention saturation is a measured training-configuration failure mechanism; controlled ImageNet initialization trial is pending.
optimization_findings.controlled_result: Same-condition rollout changes COLLISION -> SUCCESS when only official visual initialization changes; see ../recovery.json.
